hotlines.name: Pasig City Emergency Hotline (Command Center / C3, operated by Pasig City DRRMO)
hotlines.notes: The main city emergency line for fire, rescue, medical and flood calls. The DRRMO Citizen's Charter calls it the 'Command Center Hotline'. DRRMO office: C3, Pasig City Hall, Caruncho Ave. DRRMO Research and Planning Division is 8643-0000 local 306. The city cited this number in its August 2026 habagat evacuation advisories.

hotlines.name: Pasig KaTXT (text line of the emergency hotline / DRRMO)
hotlines.notes: Text-only line. The DRRMO Citizen's Charter and the DILG-NCR iDRRM profile both list it as the DRRMO mobile number.

hotlines.name: Pasig City emergency backup mobile line
hotlines.label_fil: Reserbang cellphone number para sa emergency
hotlines.notes: Only a commercial (non-official) site lists this number.

hotlines.name: Pasig City rescue line (older listing)
hotlines.notes: Listed as Pasig City's rescue hotline in news hotline roundups from 2020 (Typhoon Ulysses) and July 2024 (Typhoon Carina). Current official city posts use 8643-0000 instead, so this line may be outdated.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Hall Trunkline
hotlines.notes: Pasig Info (the city PIO) announced on 2024-04-14 that the trunkline was working again after a device migration. City Hall is on Caruncho Ave., Brgy. San Nicolas. Email: info@pasigcity.gov.ph, publicinformation@pasigcity.gov.ph (per an MMDA reply).

hotlines.name: Pasig City Traffic Department (Traffic and Parking Management Office)
hotlines.notes: Taken from an MMDA reply on X (late 2025). That reply also gives pacdpasig2011@gmail.com as a contact email. The official Pasig source could not be fetched.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Police Station (PNP, Eastern Police District)
hotlines.notes: Address: Pariancillo Park, Pasig City (Kapasigan area). contactnumbersph.com gives the old 7-digit forms 477-7953 and 949-9566, with 8 added as the prefix under the 2019 numbering change. phshirt.com lists 8477-7953 as 'Philippine National Police'. Both are secondary sources, and a 2024 reader comment on contactnumbersph asked whether the numbers were still current. National emergency line: 911.

hotlines.name: Bureau of Fire Protection - Pasig City Central Fire Station
hotlines.notes: Only a commercial site lists the mobile number. A Yellow Pages listing title puts the station on F. Manalo St., Sto. Tomas, Pasig City 1600. The landline 8641-2815 from earlier research could not be confirmed in any source this run. For fire emergencies, the city's 8643-0000 line also dispatches.

hotlines.name: Pasig City General Hospital (PCGH)
hotlines.notes: LGU hospital on M. Eusebio Ave., Maybunga. healthspace.ph lists 8643-3333 and 8642-7379; phshirt.com lists 8642-7379 and 8642-7381. Neither source says which line reaches the ER.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Children's Hospital (PCCH) - Child's Hope
hotlines.notes: Industria St. cor. Alcalde Jose St., Kapasigan. ClinicFinderPH lists local 601. Inquirer reported limited ER services from June 28, 2024, with the ER moved temporarily to the outpatient department.

hotlines.name: Rizal Medical Center (DOH-retained)
hotlines.notes: Pasig Blvd., Bagong Ilog. The number comes from a directory site (general line, open 24 hours). It could not be confirmed on rmc.doh.gov.ph.

hotlines.name: The Medical City (Ortigas) Emergency Department
hotlines.notes: ER locals 2222 or 2338; triage local 2341; trauma local 2340. From the official TMC site. The page does not say which branch it covers, but the main hospital is on Ortigas Ave., Brgy. Ugong.

conflicts.text_fil: Walang nahanap na sangguniang nag-uugnay sa 8642-1111 sa anumang ahensya ng Pasig. Hindi pa kumpirmadong linya ito ng Command Center. Ayon sa opisyal na post ng Pasig Info, 8643-0000 ang emergency hotline at 8643-1111 ang pangunahing linya ng City Hall.
conflicts.text_en: No source found ties 8642-1111 to any Pasig agency; it is not confirmed as a Command Center line. The official Pasig Info post names 8643-0000 as the emergency hotline and 8643-1111 as the City Hall trunkline.

conflicts.text_fil: Hindi makumpirma ang landline ng BFP Pasig na 8641-2815. Ang cellphone number na 0932-779-8621 lang ang nahanap, at mula ito sa isang komersyal na website. Hindi nabuksan ang mga opisyal na pahina ng BFP-NCR (ncr.bfp.gov.ph/fire-district-4).
conflicts.text_en: The BFP Pasig landline 8641-2815 could not be confirmed. The only number found was the mobile 0932-779-8621, from a commercial site. Official BFP-NCR pages (ncr.bfp.gov.ph/fire-district-4) failed to load.

conflicts.text_fil: Nakalista sa mga news roundup noong 2020 at 2024 ang 8632-0099 bilang rescue line ng Lungsod ng Pasig, pero 8643-0000 na ang ginagamit sa mga kasalukuyang opisyal na post. Hindi tiyak kung gumagana pa ang 8632-0099.
conflicts.text_en: News roundups from 2020 and 2024 list 8632-0099 as Pasig City's rescue line, but current official posts use 8643-0000. It is unclear whether 8632-0099 still works.

conflicts.text_fil: Nakalista ang 8477-7953 bilang numero ng Pasig City Police Station sa dalawang di-opisyal na sanggunian. Wala pang kumpirmasyon mula sa opisyal na sanggunian ng PNP o NCRPO.
conflicts.text_en: 8477-7953 appears to be the Pasig City Police Station (two secondary sources agree), but no official PNP or NCRPO source confirmed it.

conflicts.text_fil: Ang Citizen's Charter ng DRRMO (mga 2022) ay nagbibigay ng '641-1111 local 246' para sa Sangguniang Secretariat. Ipinahihiwatig nito na dating 8641-1111 ang trunkline; ang kasalukuyang trunkline ayon sa Pasig Info (Abril 2024) ay 8643-1111.
conflicts.text_en: The DRRMO Citizen's Charter (about 2022) gives the Sangguniang Secretariat as '641-1111 local 246'. This suggests the trunkline was once 8641-1111; the current trunkline per Pasig Info (April 2024) is 8643-1111.

conflicts.text_fil: Magkaiba ang mga numerong nakalista para sa Pasig City General Hospital. Nasa healthspace.ph ang 8643-3333 at 8642-7379. Nasa phshirt.com naman ang 8642-7379 at 8642-7381. Walang nakitang numero para sa ER.
conflicts.text_en: Pasig City General Hospital numbers differ by source: healthspace.ph gives 8643-3333 and 8642-7379, while phshirt.com gives 8642-7379 and 8642-7381. No source names the ER line.

conflicts.text_fil: Hinaharang ng opisyal na pahinang 'Emergency Contact Numbers ng Lungsod ng Pasig' (pasigcity.gov.ph/news-and-releases/emergency-contact-numbers-ng-lungsod-ng-pasig-393) ang awtomatikong pagbasa. Hindi pa nasusuri nang direkta ang buong opisyal na listahan.
conflicts.text_en: The official 'Emergency Contact Numbers ng Lungsod ng Pasig' page (pasigcity.gov.ph/news-and-releases/emergency-contact-numbers-ng-lungsod-ng-pasig-393) blocks automated fetching, so the full official list could not be checked directly.
